import.title: Import ontology
import.intro: Paste Port-style blueprint and entity JSON — including Port API exports — or pick files. Blueprints import first; references between documents are ordered automatically and, where needed, deferred and restored in a second pass.
import.replaceExistingHint: Overwrites blueprints and entities that already exist, including extending system blueprints (_team, _user).
import.strippedComputed: Computed property values removed from {{count}} entities: {{keys}}
import.notAdminBody: Only administrators can import blueprints — the {{count}} blueprint documents will be skipped.
import.checkResultSummary: Would import {{stored}} of {{total}} — {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{unchanged}} unchanged
import.failedNetwork: Import failed. Check your connection and try again.

export.failed: Couldn't export entities. Check your connection and try again.
